title: Thomas in brass bands and leaving the drinking players
summary: Thomas names the brass bands he played in and tells why he stopped working with them after a player joined church.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: What are some of the brass bands you played with?
Well, I played, I played with John Catten, Brad Baird, I played with Erika Brad Baird, and so on.
Were you a regular member or just once a while?

I was a regular member in John's band. Yeah. Yeah, I just got out after them fellas man, that fellas that like the auger too much, you know what I mean? Had a fella that he like the auger, man and Gabbert, he said, I like the auger so much, you know. So, I got this guy, me and this boy Albert, you know. Told me Albert's son. Yeah, Lutcher. Lutcher. So, we got out. Not, he was playing with him, and Remus Maschews, Bill Maschews, brother, you know. So, Remus told me one day when he was coming across, he said, you know, big kid, he said, I believe I'm going to change my way of living. I said, what you mean? He said, man, I'm going to join church. I'm going to get away from this, because I'm too old to go to penitentiary, you know what I mean? You don't get in trouble, you know. He said, I feel like the auger too much. So, he got away from me and he joined the church. That's what he did. Quit playing all together, you see. So, well, after that I didn't fool with Brad Baird too much no more, you know.
